series.name: ORION hybrid (PLUS/DUAL/PRO/ULTRA)
series.notes: PK SolarMax (Power Highway) — SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW manual primary. Axpert/Voltronic-class numeric F01–F59 + W-codes. ≠ Swiss SolarMax (solarmax.com). ONYX UL ESS and on-grid 5G/6G have NO published table. Deye F01≠this F01.

meaning.en: Cooling fan locked while unit is off.
meaning.ur: Inverter off hone par cooling fan atka hua.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before opening the cover, then spin the fan by hand to confirm it is seized.
solutions.ur: Cover kholne se pehle power off karein aur AC isolate karein, phir fan ko haath se ghuma kar confirm karein ke yeh atka hai.

solutions.en: Blow dust out of the fan and bearing; if it still does not turn freely, replace the fan motor.
solutions.ur: Fan aur bearing ki dust nikaalein; phir bhi free na ghoomay to fan motor replace kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector on the board for looseness or burn marks, reconnect it, then restart once to re-check.
solutions.ur: Board par fan connector ka looseness ya burn mark check karein, connector dobara lagayein, phir dobara check ke liye ek baar restart karein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Andar ka temperature ≈100°C se upar.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and let it cool for 15-20 minutes before touching anything inside.
solutions.ur: Unit switch off karein aur 15-20 minute thanda hone dein, us se pehle andar kuch ko haath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load, clear the vents and cooling fins of dust, and move the unit out of direct heat.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein, vents aur cooling fins ki dust saaf karein aur unit ko seedhi garmi se bahar le jayein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns after cooling, have the temperature sensor and cooling fan checked by a technician.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad bhi fault dobara aaye to temperature aur fan ko technician se check karwayein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Battery voltage limit se upar / over-charge.

solutions.en: Check battery type/qty vs program settings and terminal tightness
solutions.ur: Battery type/qty program settings se check karein aur terminals tight

solutions.en: Stop charge; disable equalization on Li; hot/swollen → evacuate + service
solutions.ur: Charge band; Li par equalization off; garam/phoola → evacuate + service

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Battery voltage cut-off se neeche.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC before checking the battery; do not work on the live bank.
solutions.ur: Battery check karne se pehle inverter switch off karein aur AC isolate karein; live bank ke saath kaam na karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage with a meter; below cut-off means deep discharge, recharge slowly before trying to start again.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery voltage naapein; cut-off se neeche hona deep discharge hai, dobara start se pehle aahista se charge karein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery; if it will not hold charge or is old or swollen, replace the bank and check the isolator and fuse.
solutions.ur: Battery ko charge karein; charge na rakhe ya purani ya phooli ho to bank replace kar dein aur isolator aur fuse check karein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.en: AC output shorted or internal converter over-temp.
meaning.ur: AC output short ya internal converter over-temp.

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein

solutions.en: Disconnect load; check wiring; airflow; persist → service
solutions.ur: Load disconnect; wiring check; airflow; rahe to service

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Output voltage 190–260 Vac window se bahar.

solutions.en: Power off the unit and reduce the applied load first; do not keep it running with output outside the window.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle unit ka power off karein aur applied load kam karein; output window se bahar rahe to ise chalaye na rakhein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, measure the AC input and output with a meter and compare with the manual window.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate hue par meter se AC input aur output naapein aur manual ki window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If input is good but output stays out of window, do not keep restarting, send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Input theek ho phir bhi output window se bahar rahe to baar baar restart na karein, unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Load ≥110% raha jab tak timer khatam.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter first and disconnect heavy loads such as pumps and motors before trying again.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle inverter switch off karein aur dobara koshish se pehle pump aur motor jese bhaari loads disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Restart with the total load kept below the inverter rating and add loads one by one while watching the display.
solutions.ur: Kul load ko inverter rating se neeche rakh kar restart karein aur display dekh kar ek ek karke loads barhayein.

solutions.en: If overload returns on light load, check output lines for a short and the motor for jamming before calling a technician.
solutions.ur: Halka load par bhi overload wapas aaye to technician bulane se pehle output lines ka short aur motor ka jam check karein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: DC bus par over-voltage (internal group 08/09/53/57).

causes.en: Load feedback pushing the DC bus up
causes.ur: Load wapas energy bhej kar bus zyada

causes.en: DC link capacitor / bleed resistor fault
causes.ur: DC link capacitor / bleed resistor kharab

solutions.en: Power off the unit and isolate AC and DC (PV isolator and battery) before any probing, the bus can stay charged.
solutions.ur: Unit ka power off karein aur kisi bhi probing se pehle AC aur DC (PV isolator + battery) isolate kar lein, bus mein charge reh sakta hai.

solutions.en: Treat the DC terminals as live even with the breakers off, and do not open the cover yourself.
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein, aur cover khud na kholein.

solutions.en: This is an internal power-stage trip, take the unit to a technician or repair centre instead of restarting repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Yeh andaruni power-stage trip hai, baar baar restart ki jagah unit ko technician ya repair centre le jayein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: DC bus soft-start sequence fail.

causes.en: Precharge relay contacts burnt / not closing
causes.ur: Precharge relay ke contacts jal gaye ya band nahi hote

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate the supply first; do not keep power-cycling a failed soft-start.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle unit switch off karein aur supply isolate karein; soft-start fail hone par baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, listen for the precharge relay click at start and check the relay and precharge resistor on the board.
solutions.ur: Power isolate hue par start par precharge relay ki click sunein aur board par relay aur precharge resistor check karein.

solutions.en: If the relay does not click, have the precharge circuit and DC link capacitor checked at a service centre.
solutions.ur: Relay click na kare to precharge circuit aur DC link capacitor ko service centre se check karwayein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.en: PV input current above limit (variant tables).
meaning.ur: PV input current limit se upar (variant tables).

causes.en: Shorted panel or damaged string cable
causes.ur: Panel short ho gaya ya string cable kharab

causes.en: MPPT setting wrong for the array
causes.ur: Array ke liye MPPT setting ghalat

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and turn the DC isolator off before touching any PV string wiring.
solutions.ur: Inverter switch off karein aur kisi bhi PV string wiring ko haath lagane se pehle DC isolator off kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the PV string with a meter for shorted panels or damaged cables, and verify the MPPT/string setting matches the array.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV string check karein ke panels short to nahi ya cables kharab to nahi, aur confirm karein ke MPPT/string setting array se match karti hai.

solutions.en: If a panel or cable is faulty, replace it; if the setting is wrong, correct it and restart once.
solutions.ur: Panel ya cable kharab ho to use badlein; setting ghalat ho to use theek kar ke ek baar restart karein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Power-stage over-current ya surge trip.

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 minute → on (DC work ke liye DC isolate)

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: DC bus par under-voltage.

causes.ur: Battery kam hai ya bank purani

causes.en: DC fuse open or wiring loose
causes.ur: DC fuse khula ya wiring dhili

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 minute → on (DC work ke liye DC isolate)

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Inverter output soft-start fail.

causes.en: Output relay not closing / contacts burnt
causes.ur: Output relay band nahi hoti ya contacts jal gaye

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC first, then check the output wiring and load for a short before restarting.
solutions.ur: Pehle power off kar ke AC isolate karein, phir restart se pehle output wiring aur load ka short check karein.

solutions.en: Restart once with no load connected to see whether the soft-start completes; if it does, add the load back gradually.
solutions.ur: Koi load lagaye baghair ek baar restart kar ke dekhein ke soft-start poora hota hai ya nahi; ho jaye to load aahista aahista barhayein.

solutions.en: If it fails again, the inverter stage needs bench diagnosis, take the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Dobara fail ho to inverter stage ki bench diagnosis chahiye, unit ko repair centre le jayein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

title.en: Over DC voltage in AC output / unbalanced
title.ur: AC output mein zyada DC / unbalanced

meaning.ur: DC injection ya output unbalance.

causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kamzor ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the unit before testing the output, DC on the AC output is unsafe to touch.
solutions.ur: Output test karne se pehle unit switch off kar ke isolate karein, AC output par DC hona haath lagane ke liye khatarnak hai.

solutions.en: After isolation, measure the DC voltage on the AC output with a meter; if it is above a safe value, stop and call a technician.
solutions.ur: Isolate karne ke baad meter se AC output par DC voltage naapein; zyada aaye to rok kar technician bulayein.

solutions.en: Do not reconnect any load until a technician has checked the output filter and relay.
solutions.ur: Output filter aur relay ke technician se check hone tak koi load dobara na lagayein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Current sensor/CT fail.

causes.en: Sensor/CT connector loose or wiring damaged
causes.ur: Sensor/CT connector dhila ya wiring kharab
Sensor board khud fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply before opening the unit; never probe the sensor wiring with power on.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle power off karein aur supply isolate karein; power on par sensor wiring ko kabhi haath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor/CT connector on the board for looseness or damage, reseat it, then power on once and read the meter.
solutions.ur: Board par sensor/CT connector ka looseness ya damage check karein, connector dobara lagayein, phir ek baar power on kar ke meter reading dekhein.

solutions.en: If the reading stays wrong, the sensor board must be replaced by a technician; do not keep restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Reading abhi bhi ghalat aaye to sensor board technician se replace karwana padega; inverter ko baar baar restart na karein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.ur: Output window se neeche (F06 group).

causes.en: Input voltage low on site supply
causes.ur: Site ki supply ka input voltage kam

solutions.en: Power off and reduce the applied load first, then check the input wiring and connections before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle power off kar ke applied load kam karein, phir restart se pehle input wiring aur connections check karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, measure input and output voltage with a meter and compare against the normal window in the manual.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate hue par meter se input aur output voltage naapein aur manual ki normal window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If input is fine but output stays low, do not keep restarting, send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Input theek ho phir bhi output kam rahe to baar baar restart na karein, unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SolarMax SM-ORION-DUAL-4KW user manual (Scribd, PK-badged fault table pp.42–49)

meaning.en: String Voc too high for inverter limit — reduce series modules.
meaning.ur: String Voc inverter limit se upar — series modules kam karein.

causes.ur: Thandi subah mein Voc ka izafa

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein

solutions.en: DC isolator OFF; re-string to nameplate max Voc
solutions.ur: DC isolator OFF karein; nameplate ke max Voc tak re-string karein
